turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{Operation}

    B -->|PROVIDE| C{Mode stated or inferable?}

    C -->|Yes| E[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
    E -->|Gaps| F[Ask up to three questions]

    I --> G
    H -->|No| J{Two empty cuts?}
    J -->|No| K{Floor still passes?}

    L --> M[Output the contract]
    K -->|Yes| G
    J -->|Yes| M
    M --> N{Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?}
    N -->|Keep negotiating| G
    N -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| O{Execution tools available?}
    O -->|No| P[Keep the gate closed]
    O -->|Yes| Q[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    Q --> R{Result}
    R -->|Success| S[Done]
    R -->|Floor failure| T[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    T --> G

    B -->|ASSAY| U[Compress the document to the floor]
```
